svg.aria-label: When an instance of WSGIHandler itself is made, WSGIHandler.__init__ calls BaseHandler.load_middleware, which goes through settings.MIDDLEWARE in reverse, importing each entry, and after the loop, in its last statement, sets _middleware_chain on the handler; on the class it is None.
svg.text: when an instance of WSGIHandler itself is made
for each entry of settings.MIDDLEWARE, in reverse
after the loop, in its last statement
sets _middleware_chain on the handler; on the class it is None
